stem:
In this figure, PQ and RS are parallel.

[Image: Parallel lines PQ and RS intersected by a transversal]

Of the following, which pair of angles has the sum of 180°?
figure_description: Two horizontal parallel lines with arrowheads at both ends are intersected by a transversal line that slopes upward from lower-left to upper-right. The upper horizontal line has label P at its left end and Q at its right end. The lower horizontal line has label R at its left end and S at its right end. At the intersection with line PQ, four angles are numbered: angle 1 in the upper-left, angle 2 in the upper-right, angle 3 in the lower-right, and angle 4 in the lower-left. At the intersection with line RS, four angles are numbered: angle 5 in the upper-left, angle 6 in the upper-right, angle 7 in the lower-right, and angle 8 in the lower-left.
